spec.statement:
CREATE TABLE bayno_latest_assignment (
    PRIMARY KEY (carrier, flight_number, first_leg_dep_date, departure_airport) NOT ENFORCED
) DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(carrier, flight_number, first_leg_dep_date, departure_airport) INTO 1 BUCKETS
WITH ('changelog.mode' = 'upsert')
AS SELECT COALESCE(carrier, '') AS carrier,
          COALESCE(flight_number, '') AS flight_number,
          COALESCE(first_leg_dep_date, '') AS first_leg_dep_date,
          COALESCE(departure_airport, '') AS departure_airport,
          file_id, line_number, source_file, source_system, feed_type,
          file_sequence, record_type, scheduled_dep_time, bay_number
FROM (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY carrier, flight_number, first_leg_dep_date, departure_airport
        ORDER BY source_file DESC, line_number DESC
    ) AS rn
    FROM bayno_assignment_history
    WHERE carrier IS NOT NULL AND flight_number IS NOT NULL
      AND first_leg_dep_date IS NOT NULL AND departure_airport IS NOT NULL
)
WHERE rn = 1;
